en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force as easterly winds continue
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory reported sustained winds exceeding 40 km/h from the east overnight, with gusts reaching gale force at exposed locations including Waglan Island and Tap Mun.
body: The Strong Monsoon Signal remained in force early on Wednesday after the Hong Kong Observatory issued it at 10:10 pm on Tuesday. Strong easterly winds with mean speeds above 40 kilometres per hour were expected to persist, with gusts occasionally reaching gale force.

In the hour ending 1:30 am, maximum sustained winds of 64 km/h were recorded at Waglan Island, 62 km/h at Tap Mun and 50 km/h at Tai Po Kau, with respective maximum gusts of 73, 80 and 71 km/h. The Observatory advised the public to take precautions against strong gusty winds, secure loose objects and stay away from the shoreline because of rough seas.

The local forecast called for mainly cloudy conditions with a few showers and isolated squally thunderstorms at first, followed by sunny intervals. Temperatures were expected to range from about 28 degrees in the morning to around 32 degrees in urban areas.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號繼續生效 偏東強風持續
zh.dek: 天文台指通宵吹偏東強風，平均風速超過每小時40公里，離岸及高地陣風間中達烈風程度，橫瀾島及塔門等地錄得較高風速。
body: 強烈季候風信號於周二晚上10時10分發出後，周三清晨繼續生效。天文台預料本港吹偏東強風，平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
截至凌晨1時30分的過去一小時，橫瀾島錄得最高持續風速每小時64公里、最高陣風73公里；塔門持續風速62公里、陣風80公里；大埔滘持續風速50公里、陣風71公里。天文台提醒市民提防強陣風，將花盆等易被吹倒物件搬入室內，並遠離岸邊及停止水上活動。
本港今日大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，初時有幾陣狂風雷暴；日間短暫時間有陽光，市區最高氣溫約32度。
